description: Paraphrase relevance queries over the installed `pathspec` package (a second codebase, so ranking changes are not judged only on CodePulse's own source). Role: HELD-OUT set (not consulted while choosing settings; evaluated once at the end). Queries were written from reading each symbol's code, BEFORE any search result was looked at, and deliberately do not reuse docstring wording.
source_repository: the installed `pathspec` package directory (site-packages/pathspec); version pinned by CodePulse's dependency ranges
expected_file_path_convention: relative to the pathspec/ package directory
